title: Microsoft&\#x27;s ONNX Runtime repository reportedly disappears from GitHub
summary: Microsoft&\#x27;s ONNX Runtime repository at github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime is reported to have gone dark on GitHub as of November 17, 2026, with no advance warning or official explanation in the supplied material. The item does not confirm whether the repository was removed, made private, restricted, or otherwise unavailable, so the operational and security implications remain unverified. A commenter said evaluation pipelines began failing that morning, but no Microsoft statement or independent confirmation was provided.
